name: TerraFirmaGreg
summary:
The TerraFirmaGreg group of modpacks are a special hybrid of two titans of modding: TerraFirmaCraft (a deep, realistic survival overhaul) and GregTech (an expansive tech mod famous for its realistic chemistry and complex progression). Both have been seamlessly blended together for a stone-age-to-space-age experience.

Are you looking for a longer modpack where every step feels rewarding, and you're constantly building upon previous technologies in a way that feels seamless and natural?
Do you want a modpack where every mod is carefully integrated instead of just thrown in?
Do you dislike magic mods, or want to try a tech modpack that feels less "minecrafty" with its automation?
Or do you just want to try out GregTech without losing years of your life? Then TerraFirmaGreg may be the modpack for you!

TerraFirmaGreg-Modern (for 1.20.1) is a modern iteration built on GregTech Modern. It emphasizes seamless integration of all mods (Create, Ad Astra, AE2) along with a ton of custom content for a seamless and unique experience. This is a more "polished" experience with modern mechanics.

TerraFirmaGreg-Vintage (for 1.12.2) is the classic version based on GregTech CEu. It offers "survival as it should be" - harsh, realistic, and full of challenges, with classic tech mods like Galacticraft and OpenComputers.

Both packs feature natural progression, deep integration, both survival and automation, a non-magic focus, and tons of in-game help in the form of quests and guides so you can easily navigate your way.
